items.title: Teaching Python with three kinds of AI
items.summary: I teach Python for a living. In this talk, I describe how I used AI in three different ways to help people learn and practice Python — in my corporate training, on my online platform, and as a companion to my books and newsletters.

items.title: Vibe Coding on the HCL Domino Platform By Mathias Blom
items.summary: What happens when modern AI-assisted development meets one of the most proven enterprise application platforms? In this session, we explore how "Vibe Coding" is changing the way applications are built on HCL Domino. Through live demonstrations and real-world examples, you'll see how AI tools can accelerate development, generate code, simplify complex tasks, and help both new and experienced Domino developers become more productive. We'll cover practical use cases, lessons learned, and how AI-assisted development can streamline everything from LotusScript/Java coding and Formula Language to web applications, REST integrations, and Native Notes applications. Whether you're a Domino developer, administrator, architect, or simply curious about the future of software development, this session will show how AI-powered coding is reshaping the Domino development experience. Takeaways - Using AI to generate forms, views, agents, and other design elements, with REST and DXL on HCL Domino - Using React and Angular as modern front ends for HCL Domino applications - Practical tips, demos, and real-world experiences

items.title: 背中から、背中へ　ー 社外コミュニティで学んだ「雑に背中を押す」という恩送り ー / easygoing encouragement and pay forward to community
items.summary: スクラム祭り2026 大阪トラック日々の業務であと一歩踏み出せずにいる方やチームや後輩の背中を押す側になりたい方に向けた、社外コミュニティを通じた「雑に背中を押す」という恩送りの事例と方法についての話です
